mycinema.ponder.tag.cinema_operations.de: Build, connect and operate a complete MyCinema venue
mycinema.ponder.manager_terminal.header: Run a cinema from the Control Terminal
mycinema.ponder.manager_terminal.text_1: The Control Terminal is the authority for one cinema. Right-click it to name the venue, set its time zone and create halls.
mycinema.ponder.manager_terminal.text_2: Use a Linking Card on this terminal, choose a hall, then use the card on that hall's TMS.
mycinema.ponder.manager_terminal.text_3: Build the film catalogue and ordered programmes before adding scheduled shows. A saved show does not enable automation by itself.
mycinema.ponder.manager_terminal.text_4: Enable scheduling only after checking the cinema time zone, source permissions and the hall's loaded TMS.
mycinema.ponder.manager_terminal.text_5: Information panels and scene outputs follow the hall bindings while playback authority remains at the terminal and TMS.
mycinema.ponder.tms_terminal.header: Prepare and control a hall with TMS
mycinema.ponder.tms_terminal.text_1: Each hall uses one TMS. It owns the media session and shares the decoded picture with its linked projector endpoints.
mycinema.ponder.tms_terminal.text_2: Open Projection Group and bind the nearby projector endpoints. Group actions fail rather than silently dropping a missing endpoint.
mycinema.ponder.tms_terminal.text_3: Load a permitted URL or shared local path. Loading leaves the source paused; press Play only after checking the hall.
mycinema.ponder.tms_terminal.text_4: Choose the audio origin: screen centre, calibrated audience centre, or the projector midpoint when that group is available.
mycinema.ponder.tms_terminal.text_5: When the TMS says it is programme-managed, use the bound Control Terminal instead of trying to override it locally.
mycinema.ponder.cinema_projector.text_1: Place the projector on a clear, solid floor with its optical face aimed at the screen.
mycinema.ponder.cinema_projector.text_2: Bind it from the hall's TMS. Linked controls keep group playback and calibration on the terminal.
mycinema.ponder.cinema_projector.text_3: The projector does not start another decoder: it renders the TMS display, so synchronized endpoints share one media clock.
mycinema.ponder.cinema_projector.text_4: Turn linked controls off before opening one projector for individual WaterFrames calibration, then restore the group.
mycinema.ponder.imax_gt_projector.text_1: The IMAX GT item uses the dedicated parallel-cabinet artwork and a separate public registry ID.
mycinema.ponder.imax_gt_projector.text_2: Placement reserves the complete 3 × 2 × 3 machine volume. Clear the space and support every required floor cell first.
mycinema.ponder.imax_gt_projector.text_3: One placed IMAX GT machine is one projector endpoint, even though its model shows the parallel cabinet assembly.
mycinema.ponder.imax_gt_projector.text_4: Bind endpoints from the TMS and calibrate their projected image faces before selecting the group audio origin.
mycinema.ponder.imax_gt_projector.text_5: For a 1.43:1 auditorium, prepare matching source framing and screen geometry; MyCinema does not crop a film into that ratio automatically.
mycinema.ponder.information_panel.text_1: The Information Panel is a public, read-only view of the cinema's current and next shows.
mycinema.ponder.information_panel.text_2: Select a hall on a Linking Card at the Control Terminal, then use the card on this panel.
mycinema.ponder.information_panel.text_3: Bind it to a hall for a single screen, or configure the supported lobby view when you need the venue schedule.
mycinema.ponder.information_panel.text_4: Poster and programme data come from the authoritative catalogue; the panel never gains playback controls.
mycinema.ponder.seat_guide.text_1: Place cinema seats on solid full-height support, facing the screen, with a clear footwell and headroom for safe exit.
mycinema.ponder.seat_guide.text_2: Use the Seat Binding Card on the Control Terminal first, then choose a hall, zone, row and starting seat number.
mycinema.ponder.seat_guide.text_3: Continuous numbering records only successful new seat clicks. Whole-row numbering previews the first-to-last straight row before one atomic save.
mycinema.ponder.seat_guide.text_4: Place a Seat / Row Guide where guests can see it and configure the row or seat range it should display.
mycinema.ponder.seat_guide.text_5: Breaking and replacing a chair creates a new physical identity; remove the old binding explicitly before registering its replacement.
mycinema.ponder.staff_reader.text_1: The Staff Reader controls a local staff entry. It grants door access, not cinema playback authority.
mycinema.ponder.staff_reader.text_2: With the Access Pairing Card, select the Control Terminal, then this reader, then the cinema door it releases.
mycinema.ponder.staff_reader.text_3: Open the reader as the cinema owner to issue role-limited staff cards and review the current configuration.
mycinema.ponder.staff_reader.text_4: Use a written Staff Card on the reader. Every entry rechecks the live cinema, role and paired door.
mycinema.ponder.staff_reader.text_5: The paired inside exit remains the recovery path; do not use staff cards as a substitute for emergency egress design.
